# vaults.cash

> One-call Uniswap v4 liquidity positions on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663).
> Convert USDG into slippage-bounded, atomic LP position call-batches. Fee
> 0.30% of converted amounts, embedded in the returned calls. Self-custodial:
> the executing wallet owns the position NFT; vaults.cash never holds funds.

## MCP server (recommended for agents)

Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://vaults.cash/api/mcp/mcp
Tools: list_markets, get_balances, get_deposit_quote, build_deposit_calls,
list_positions, build_withdraw_calls, build_collect_calls.
Build tools return {to, value, data} call batches you sign with your own wallet.

## REST API (no auth, JSON)

- GET  /api/agent/markets — listed markets, live prices, pool ids, docs
- GET  /api/agent/quote?market=ETH&amountUsd=100&preset=balanced — read-only deposit split
- POST /api/agent/zap-plan {market, amountUsd, owner, preset?, widthPct?, slippageBps?} — executable calls: USDG -> LP position
- GET  /api/agent/positions?owner=0x… — live positions for a wallet
- POST /api/agent/withdraw-plan {owner, tokenId, slippageBps?} — executable calls: position -> USDG

Presets: full (never rebalance) | balanced (±15%) | aggressive (±5%).
Execute calls IN ORDER from `owner`; batch atomically if the wallet supports it
(ERC-4337/EIP-7702). Plans embed slippage bounds and expire — rebuild after ~60s.

## Important

- Chain: Robinhood Chain, id 4663, RPC https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com, gas ETH.
- USDG (6 decimals) is the deposit/withdraw currency.
- Markets flagged restricted=true are tokenized stocks: not offerable to US
  persons or in CA/GB/CH/AE. Only request plans for eligible parties.
- LP positions carry impermanent-loss risk and can go out of range.

## Human app

Same engine with a consumer UI at https://vaults.cash — Privy login, sponsored gas.
Disclosures: https://vaults.cash/disclosures
